resources.name: YAMNet (MediaPipe Audio Classifier TFLite build, version 1)
resources.task: Frame-level multi-label audio event tagging over 521 AudioSet classes.

verified_interface.input: float32 mono waveform, 15600 samples at 16 kHz (0.975 s), expected range [-1, 1]; log-mel frontend (25 ms window, 10 ms hop, 64 bands 125-7500 Hz) is inside the graph (RFFT2D, LOG ops)
verified_interface.output: [1, 521] scores after an in-graph LOGISTIC op: independent per-class sigmoid scores, NOT softmax probabilities and NOT calibrated
verified_interface.quantization: internal activations are int8 (QUANTIZE/DEQUANTIZE ops) despite the 'float32' path; output scores are multiples of 1/256
verified_interface.label_map: 521 labels embedded as yamnet_label_list.txt; order verified identical to yamnet_class_map.csv
verified_interface.embedding: 1024-d pooled activation (tensor 'tower0/network/layer28/reduce_mean', int8, dequantized) readable with experimental_preserve_all_tensors

resources.training_data: AudioSet (YouTube segments), per tensorflow/models YAMNet README

terms.weights: Released by Google in the Apache-2.0 tensorflow/models YAMNet project. The MediaPipe TFLite conversion has no standalone model card reachable from this session; treat as Apache-2.0 pending primary-source re-verification.

resources.attribution: YAMNet by Manoj Plakal and Dan Ellis (Google); AudioSet ontology by Google Inc. (CC BY-SA 4.0).
use_restrictions: Weights are fetched from Google, never committed.
Do not assume commercial permission until weights terms are re-verified.
resources.contamination_notes: Trained on AudioSet YouTube clips. ESC-50 clips come from Freesound; overlap is unlikely but unverified.

resources.name: EfficientDet-Lite0 (MediaPipe Object Detector float32 build, version 1)
resources.task: COCO 80-class object detection; only 'cat' and 'dog' are used by default.

verified_interface.input: [1, 320, 320, 3] float32 RGB, normalized (x - 127.5) / 127.5 (NormalizationOptions in embedded TFLite metadata)
verified_interface.output: raw anchor outputs: boxes [1, 19206, 4] (YXHW offsets) and scores [1, 19206, 90] after an in-graph LOGISTIC op; no in-graph NMS
verified_interface.decoding: Embedded MediaPipe DETECTOR_METADATA: 19206 fixed anchors, x/y/w/h scale 1.0, exponential box size, sigmoid_score=false (already applied). Box format YXHW per MediaPipe detection_postprocessing_graph.cc. NMS implemented in this package.
verified_interface.label_map: Embedded labels.txt: 90 COCO category slots with '???' placeholders; index 16 = cat, index 17 = dog (0-based).

resources.class_map_notes: COCO has no door, leash, litter box, or pet-bowl classes. 'bowl', 'frisbee', 'sports ball' and 'teddy bear' exist but are not validated for pet contexts.

terms.weights: No standalone model card; MediaPipe framework and TF EfficientDet-Lite releases are Apache-2.0 by secondary evidence. Primary model page not reachable from this session. Research profile only until re-verified.
terms.training_data: COCO annotations CC BY 4.0; COCO images carry Flickr terms.

resources.attribution: EfficientDet (Tan, Pang, Le, 2020); MediaPipe by Google.
use_restrictions: Weights fetched from Google, never committed.
resources.contamination_notes: COCO and Open Images both draw from Flickr; identical photos across them are possible and unaudited.

resources.name: ESC-50: Dataset for Environmental Sound Classification
resources.task: Environmental sound classification, 50 classes, 5 s clips. Used for cat/dog/other sound-event evaluation only; not an intent dataset.

observed_counts.per_fold: 8 cat, 8 dog, 384 other in each of 5 folds

grouping_findings: Verified: 4 Freesound source recordings appear in two folds each, always under different classes (clock_tick/clock_alarm: 131943, 209698; hen/rooster: 134049, 234879). No cat or dog source spans folds.
resources.label_provenance: Manual clip-level labels by the dataset author; clips extracted from Freesound recordings.

terms.data: CC BY-NC 3.0 for the collection; ESC-10 subset CC BY 3.0; per-clip Freesound licenses (CC0 869, CC-BY 901, CC-BY-NC 169, CC-Sampling+ 60) parsed into manifests/esc50_files.csv

resources.attribution: K. J. Piczak, ESC: Dataset for Environmental Sound Classification, ACM MM 2015; per-clip Freesound authors in manifests/esc50_files.csv.
use_restrictions: Non-commercial research use; trained artifacts inherit CC BY-NC 3.0 obligations.
Audio is not committed to Git.
